scientific_integrity: The claim is proved analytically for every existing equal-order generalized quadrangle. Finite calculations are corroborative and not substituted for the all-orders proof. A mathematically equivalent unindexed treatment may exist.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge incidence graph of an existing finite \(\operatorname{GQ}(q,q)\), \(q\ge2\); only prime \(q=2,3,5\) examples directly executed; no unequal-order, weighted, or existence assertions. Independent validation not performed.
title: Cubic collapse of generalized roundness on generalized-quadrangle incidence graphs
